description: Search items across a board by content or sender. Returns matches with preview snippets. Matches can be email threads (`threadId`), task cards (`cardId`/`title`), or WhatsApp conversations (`cardId`/`contact`). Note: matching is on whole words with no stemming, so "cancellation" will not match "cancelling". If a search returns nothing, try a shorter or differently spelled term, or use filter_threads or list_threads.

boardId.description: The board ID to search within

query.description: Search query text (must not be empty)

searchBy.description: Search by thread content (subject/body) or by sender email. Defaults to content.

name: search_threads
title: Search threads
